legacy.$description: Deprecated tokens, kept so an app's own CSS that reads them still works until 5.0.0 (rule 52). --ink-mix is how much of the accent the ink kept against black: all of it on the dark ramps and 55% on the light one. The stylesheet no longer reads it, so it needs the theme's own selectors rather than a light-dark(), which only takes colours. npx glimstone-migrate rewrites the mix it was made for.
